scope: Exploratory matched-frame diagnostic on the existing seven sequence 11 source-target pairs; two label-free gates use targets 51 and 172.
arms: Keep the archived automatic Lean mask as the primary reference. Using its target-frame bounding box, run the existing native SAM2 image predictor with box alone, box plus fixed-random positive/negative points, box plus maximum/minimum foreground feature scores, box plus maximum/minimum foreground-background FPN scores, or box plus maximum/minimum RGB contrast scores. Points are selected within the current automatic mask, from saved temporally derived maps. No ground truth, detector, re-detection, new confidence threshold, learned head or propagation intervention is used.
validation: Two independent short gates must yield identical input receipts and output mask hashes. Confirm feature map and source masks against the previously reproduced capture; check point-mask membership, score shapes, baseline source identity, fixed random controls, output geometry, unchanged model weights and no labels until all predictions are written. Score full pilot independently against fixed archived predictions.
limitations: The mask bounding box is derived from the target prediction, not the original YOLO box, and the SAM2 image decoder has no temporal memory. This is a new fixed-frame prompt procedure, not original Lean inference; its results cannot establish improved propagation or isolate early features from the decoder. Retrospective selected sequence and potentially incomplete labels.
